entries.name: Xenia / Xenia Canary
entries.authors: Ben Vanik and the Xenia project contributors (xenia-project); Xenia Canary contributors
entries.what: The oracle and the semantic reference for the whole platform layer. Ported code (with attribution headers): Xenos microcode/CF walk, texture tiling, EDRAM model, gamma ramp, PM4 trace format, XMA decoder + audio output path, KPCR/KTHREAD layouts, physical-address lookup, XAM content/profile, conformance reference functions, the FFmpeg config overlay, draw resolution scaling (gfx/res_scale.*; the scaled EDRAM, resolve, texture and present paths in gfx/d3d12_pm4_*.cpp / gfx/d3d12_backend.cpp: draw_resolution_scale_x/_y, the scaled resolve memory, the texture key scaled_resolve). Embedded binaries: Xenia's resolve_* and texture_load_* compute shaders, incl. their *_scaled variants (#included by gfx/d3d12_pm4_shmem.cpp as the DXBC headers Xenia's build makes, compiled at build time with fxc from the sources vendored verbatim in third_party/xenia-shaders by tools/vendor_xenia_shaders.py; cmake/xenia_shaders.cmake). Native resolve (gfx/native_resolve.inc): Xenia's resolve_* compute shaders reproduced with a host render-target read in place of the EDRAM load, compiled at run time against the embedded xesl include closure (third_party/xenia-shaders/xesl_embed.inc, generated verbatim by tools/gen_xesl_embed.py). Shared-memory write tracking (kernel/gpu_write_watch.*): the model of PhysicalHeap::EnableAccessCallbacks / TriggerCallbacks and SharedMemory::MakeRangeValid / MemoryInvalidationCallback. The present chain's post-process anti-aliasing (gfx/d3d12_present_chain.cpp): Xenia's FXAA compute shaders (fxaa_cs, fxaa_extreme_cs, built the same way from third_party/xenia-shaders) with Xenia's FXAA root signature, after a luma pass reproducing apply_gamma_*_fxaa_luma (postprocess_antialiasing). Present chain (gfx/d3d12_present_chain.cpp, iter-466 res4k): Xenia's guest-output pixel shaders (guest_output_bilinear, _ffx_cas_resample, _ffx_cas_sharpen, _ffx_fsr_easu, _ffx_fsr_rcas; built the same way from third_party/xenia-shaders) and its presenter's effect flow (presenter.cc BuildGuestOutputPaintFlow).

entries.name: koolkdev/libertyv xma2dec.c (historical credit, no code used)
entries.authors: koolkdev
entries.what: A 216-line libav wrapper (libav_wrapper/xma2dec.c @629cfae5, 2013; the repository publishes no licence) that decoded XMA by rewriting each packet header for FFmpeg's WMA Pro decoder. Xenia's first XMA decoder adapted it (f31b34256b, 2015-05-22), dropped the header rewrite (0f9cd8cfb, 2015-08-22) and the rest of the approach in the 2020 packet-parser rewrite that introduced xmaframes (6547fa174, 2020-06-24); every later Xenia XMA context, including the xma_context_new.cc we port (122f58c9d, 2024), kept the credit line. No xma2dec.c code is in this tree: tools/provenance_check.py finds none in any tracked C/C++ file while detecting the 2015 adaptation (iter-467, archive/v1_xma/provenance). XMA frames are decoded by FFmpeg (ffmpeg-xenia); the packet logic is Xenia's BSD-3 code (xenia).

entries.name: FFmpeg (Xenia's fork with the XMA frames decoder)
entries.authors: The FFmpeg developers; the xmaframes branch is published at github.com/has207/FFmpeg and pinned by Xenia Canary
entries.what: libavcodec + libavutil (mp3, wmapro, wmav2, xmaframes; LGPL-only configuration, no asm) built from source as ffmpeg_xenia.dll, delay-loaded by the XMA decoder port. This is the XMA frame decoder (xmaframes, in wmaprodec.c, LGPL-2.1-or-later). Header scan of every file the DLL compiles (iter-467, archive/v1_xma/ffmpeg_licence_scan.json): 408 LGPL-2.1+, no GPL file compiled (macos_kperf.h sits behind CONFIG_MACOS_KPERF, unset), plus permissive files whose notices THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md carries: IJG (jfdctfst.c, jfdctint_template.c, jrevdct.c), ISC (faandct.c), MIT (avsscanf.c, from musl), zlib (adler32.c).

entries.name: XenonRecomp (and XenonAnalyse)
entries.authors: hedge-dev and contributors (created by Skyth; XenonAnalyse by Sajid, per the UnleashedRecomp README)
entries.what: The PowerPC -> C++ static recompiler that generates guest/ppc/ from the game's XEX, plus its runtime header ppc_context.h (compiled into the exe; our modified copy is tools/regen/hand/ppc_context.h). Our patches to it live in tools/regen/patches/. tools/decrypt_xex2.py follows its xex.cpp decryption logic.

entries.name: DirectX Shader Compiler (dxcompiler.dll, dxil.dll)
entries.authors: Microsoft and the LLVM / DirectXShaderCompiler contributors
entries.what: DXC v1.8.2407 binaries loaded at runtime for in-game shader translation: the official release zip (dxc_2024_07_31.zip), downloaded at configure time and SHA-256 checked by cmake/dxc_release.cmake, copied next to the exe by cmake/xenos_xlat.cmake (byte-identical to the XenosRecomp dxc-bin copies the offline cache was built with). dxcompiler.dll: LLVM release licence (NCSA) + third-party notices; dxil.dll: Microsoft Software License Terms (distributable code).

entries.name: Dear ImGui
entries.authors: Omar Cornut and the Dear ImGui contributors
entries.what: Immediate-mode GUI library that draws the in-game mod library (gfx/mod_library_ui.cpp, docs/MODS.md 'The mod library'): font atlas (stb_truetype), draw lists and its DirectX 12 renderer backend. Vendored unmodified: v1.91.9b (commit 4806a1924ff6181180bf5e4b8b79ab4394118875, taken from reference/xenia-canary/third_party/imgui) - the imgui core, imstb_rectpack.h / imstb_textedit.h / imstb_truetype.h (Sean Barrett's stb libraries, public domain or MIT, as modified by Dear ImGui) and backends/imgui_impl_dx12. Our widgets are custom draw code; no demo window and no other backend is built.

entries.name: XenosRecomp
entries.authors: hedge-dev and contributors (created by Skyth, per the UnleashedRecomp README)
entries.what: Xenos shader -> HLSL/DXIL translator: used offline to build data/shader_cache and compiled INTO the game (static library xenos_xlat, cmake/xenos_xlat.cmake) for runtime translation of cache misses. The submodule third_party/XenosRecomp pins upstream 990d03b; our patch series (tools/xenosrecomp/*.patch, partly ports of Xenia code) is applied by tools/xenosrecomp/prepare.py to an export of that commit in the build tree (the submodule stays pristine).

entries.name: FREE Input Prompts Pack
entries.authors: Julio Cacko (JulioCacko)
entries.what: Controller (PlayStation 4/5, Switch) and keyboard/mouse button glyphs for the port's device-matched input prompts (docs/INPUT_GLYPHS.md). Shipped: an unmodified subset of 'Universal Version.zip' (sha256 f6c75921b9d6ab2cb2b5249f547c7b7ba19e22da9f4f3b45693cf0912f25ded0) under data/glyphs/juliocacko_input_prompts/ - PS4/PS5 Default face buttons (_Color), shoulders, triggers, Options/Share, d-pad, sticks; Switch Default; every White keyboard and mouse key (rebinds); one blank key - with SOURCE.md (author, URLs, subset, why) and LICENSE.txt (the CC0 1.0 legal code text, added by us: the pack itself has no licence file). No attribution required (but appreciated!)'. credit.txt in the download points at the author's Gumroad listing (https://juliocacko.gumroad.com/l/free-input-pack). CC0 covers the author's copyright only: console button symbols (PlayStation shapes, Xbox letters/colours, Nintendo labels) stay trademarks of their owners.

entries.name: Saira (font)
entries.authors: Omnibus-Type (Hector Gatti and the Saira Project Authors)
entries.what: The mod library's typeface: static instances of the Saira variable fonts from google/fonts (ofl/saira, downloaded 2026-10-03; source sha256 in tools/modlib/make_fonts.py), made with fontTools (Expanded Black Italic, Expanded Bold Italic, Expanded SemiBold, Medium), subset to Latin + Latin-1 and renamed 'Saira SR' as a Modified Version (Saira's OFL declares no Reserved Font Name). Shipped under data/fonts/saira/ with the licence text (OFL.txt).

entries.name: Unleashed Recompiled (UnleashedRecomp)
entries.authors: hedge-dev; Skyth, Sajid, Hyper, Dario and the contributors listed in its README
entries.what: Structural reference only: the D3D12 host structure (gpu/video.cpp: render thread, PSO cache, command queue shape) and the HLE hook surface. Submodule under reference/, never compiled or linked. Audit 2026-10-02: no UnleashedRecomp code in our tree (line-level scan of every tracked source against its 201 source files; the only matches are licence boilerplate, XenosRecomp ABI strings and one-line idioms). Since the project is GPL-3.0-only (2026-10-23), its code may be reused under its licence, with a credits entry and the source named in the file.
